possessed).

--उदंच् a. (प्रागुदंच्)
northeastern.

northeast.
--कर्मन् (प्राक्कर्मन्) n. {1}
an action done in a former life. {2}
a preliminary medical treatment. {3}
a preliminary action in general.
--कालः (प्राक्कालः) a former age.

former times, old, ancient.

of a blade of such Kuśa grass.

life.

manifested from the first in a
distinct form.

{1} going before, preceding. {2} a
precursor, forerunner. {3} going
eastward.

female organ of generation.
--चिरं (
प्राक्चिरं) ind. in due or good time,
before too late.
--जन्मन् (प्राग्जन्मन्)
n.,
--जातिः (प्राग्जातिः) f. a former
birth.
--ज्योतिषः (प्राग्योतिषः) {1} N.
of country, also called Kāmarūpa. {2}
the people of this country (pl.)

epithet of Viṣṇu.

a. (प्राग्द्वार &c.) having doors facing
the east.

आचारेणावसन्नोपि पुतर्लेखय ते यदि ।

प्राक्प्रहारः) the first blow.

(फा) ल्गुनी (प्राक्फल्गुनी) the

Jupiter.

medicine before meals.
--भागः (
प्राग्भागः) {1} the front. {2} the forepart.

(of anything);

a large quantity, heap, multitude,

dynasty or generation.

प्राङ्न्यायः q. v.
